name: Nightglass
author: E. T. Carter
description: Looking out through a rain-beaded night window: drops and slow winding runnels on misted glass each hold a sharp inverted fleck of the city, while beyond them soft mint towers with blurred window grids, red aviation lamps and drifting street-lamp bokeh sit under a wine-dark sky, layered with haze and motes. Worn dark glazing bars cross the pane on the left third and low down.

params.label: Rain
params.effect: How many drops bead the glass and how strongly the runnels flow.

params.label: Condensation
params.effect: How much fog clouds the pane and softens the city outside the drops.

params.label: Haze
params.effect: Haze banks and drifting motes hanging between the layers of the city.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed of the runnels, the traffic and the drifting haze.
